answer: Sybil resistance mandates each AI agent identity stake a substantial, scarce token. Each valid identity thus becomes an economic 'island' in the network, intrinsically protected by a 'reef' of capital. An attacker seeking to flood the system with fake identities must acquire an equivalent stake for every single one, making a 'gale' of Sybils prohibitively expensive. This directly scales the attack cost with desired influence.
